remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DWINVER=0x600)

spec2def(normaliz.dll normaliz.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# normaliz.dll is all Rust (normaliz-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# IdnToAscii.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-rust/src/normaliz/IdnToAscii.rs)
# IdnToUnicode.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-rust/src/normaliz/IdnToUnicode.rs)
# nameprep.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-rust/src/normaliz/nameprep/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# normalize.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-rust/src/normaliz/normalize.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(normaliz_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(normaliz_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(normaliz normaliz-cargo normaliz.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE normaliz-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS normaliz_shims)
